one_minute_value_explanation: v10.7.1 makes the v10.7 Capability Coverage Gate stricter: AOF now checks that completed work has schema-valid actor outputs, team aggregation, and Council judgment rather than only nominal actor assignment evidence.
thirty_second_version_delta: v10.7.0 introduced capability coverage; v10.7.1 closes the audit blind spot where done work could pass without a validated actor output chain.
product_review_trigger: If AOF claims capability coverage while actor role results, team output, or Council review refs are missing or schema-invalid, reopen the audit as a release-blocking product issue.
not_proven: v10.7.1 proves stronger structural coverage only; it still does not prove semantic expert correctness, user value, market truth, or production safety.
